motion.scope:
Compare Exotica camera state and actual ADC reads from exotica_motion_trace.lua.

Camera equality is a route check, not complete vehicle/physics equivalence.
Input playback equality alone does not establish that a changed game followed
the original route. Both traces must cover the same complete frame interval.
motion.camera_match_scope: Camera words only; traffic, object state and rendering phase can still differ.

identity.scope: Recomputes ordered scalar/quad-hash/material streams and compares independently recorded full-buffer/packet hashes; raw operands and pixels stay local.

samples.scope: Independent geometry preparation and immediate insertion on captured private state; shared material/vertex shader. No complete temporal/occlusion/handover acceptance.
